description: This file implements a GPIO driver for Intel SEDI hardware within the Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, power management, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: gpio_sedi_init
methods.description: Initializes the SEDI GPIO device, maps memory, and sets up IRQs.

methods.name: gpio_sedi_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions like suspend and resume.

methods.name: gpio_sedi_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked on GPIO interrupt, fires registered callbacks.

methods.name: gpio_sedi_write_raw
methods.description: Writes raw bits to GPIO pins, either setting or clearing them.

methods.name: gpio_sedi_configure
methods.description: Configures GPIO pin direction and initial state.

methods.name: gpio_sedi_get_raw
methods.description: Reads the current raw input state of GPIO pins.

methods.name: gpio_sedi_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets GPIO pins based on a mask and value.

methods.name: gpio_sedi_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode for a GPIO pin.
